tei:div.tei:p: (ka)༄༅// ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i lugs kyi tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog bzhugs so// ༄༅// na mo gu ru a pa ri mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ bla ma rje btsun kun dga'i mtshan can dang*// gnyis med rgyal dbang mgon po tshe dpag med// gang de'i zhabs la spyi bos gus btud nas// de yi tshe sgrub rang gzhan don du bri// de la 'dir tshe'i dzap la brten nas tshe sring bar byed pa'i phyag len ni/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum las/ dang po ni yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su 'byor na bla bre dang yol ba bkram/ tshe dpag med kyi sku 'bur sku'am bris sku gang 'byor pa bshams pa'i mdun nam/ ma 'byor kyang nyes pa med pas/ stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du me tog gi tshom bu brgyad pa gnyis pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi tshul du byas la/ chang las sbrus pa'i tshe zan gyi bum pa che chung ji ltar dgos pa smug rtsis byugs pa'i bum pa'i khar tshe ril gsum/ de'i dbus su srog shing btsugs pa la brten pa'i zan nor bu 'dra bar bzhag thams cad smug rtsis dmar por byas la mar gyis brgyan nor bu 'bar ba sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar ci mdzes byas pa tshom bu 'dab brgyad gcig gi steng du slob dpon la zhal phyogs par bzhag 'dab brgyad gcig gi steng du tshe chang bum pa'am/ shu ba lta bu gang rung mang nyung la dpag pa'i snod gtsang ma chang gis bkang ba dar dmar pos mgul bcings pa bzhag de gnyis kyi bar gang bde bar snod gcig tu tshe ril slob ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa chang gis sbrus shing 'byor na bu ram cung zad khog tu bcug pa dang bcas pa smug rtsis byugs pa bzhag tshe zan/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril rnams la byin rlabs rten yid ches pa gang mang bsre ba gal che ste sems can la phan pa'i ched yin/ de rnams kyi mdun du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar gcig bshams pa'i bar ji ltar rigs par dkar gtor zlum po pad 'dab bzhis brgyan pa gsum bsham/

gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed mdun bskyed/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'o// dang po ni/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ snang gsal/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ aḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da'i bar dang*/ dharma ra ṇi tshar gsum dril gsil rol mo dang bcas pas mchod pa byin gyis brlab/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus da nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la= /dam pa'i chos rnams la= /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la= /lan nyi shu rtsa gcig sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang skad cig gis mgon po tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥn ma ār+ya a pa ri mi ta sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dhū paṃ/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shab+da āḥhūm̐/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs gsum dang*/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs/ tshad med bzhi tshar gcig dang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong bar gyur/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ sham thabs gsol ba/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa mtshan dang dpe byad kyis brgyan pa'i sku can du gyur pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i stod du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan/ tshogs zhing ltar shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// rang gi snying ga'i stod kyi zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de'i mtha' mar a mā ra ṇis bskor bar dmigs la/

de las 'od 'phros lus kyi nang gang*/ rang gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir spros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshe dpag med kyi go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer gyi sna la mchod pa'i tshogs spros nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems rnams mchod pas rang gi tshogs rdzogs shing sgrib pa dag par bsam/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam tshe dpag tu med pa sogs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu thams cad 'chi med tshe yi chu rgyun gyi rnam par spyan drangs rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas lus kyi nang thams cad gang bas sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i las ngan thams cad dag tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsams la/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla'o// de nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib byang zhing dag pa dang*/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i go 'phang la 'god par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces bdag bskyed pa'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni/ a mṛ tas tshe zan/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril la sogs pa bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong par gyur ces pa nas/ 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan/ ces pa'i bar bdag bskyed ltar sgrub cing*/ mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa yang gong bzhin byas la/ gtor ma chus sbyangs nas/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la gtor ma dang po/ oṃ a mi tā bha hrīḥ.oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ā d+ya nut+pan+na twāta oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

lan gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul/ mchod bstod gong bzhin byas la/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di mgon po tshe dpag med pa la 'bul lo// bdag dang rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas pa la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/ 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ gtor ma gnyis pa gur zhal sogs rang rang gis gang 'bul pa'i chos skyong la sngags tsam gyis 'bul/ phyi mchod dang*/ gang gis 'phrul dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar thob nas thub ba'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs srung ba'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la bstod par bgyi// zhes bstod la re ba med pa'i tshul gyis rang gi 'dod don gang yod kyi phrin las bcol/ gtor ma gsum pa a kā ros gzhi bdag la 'bul tshar pa dang*/ tshe sgrub kyi dngos gzhi 'byung bzhi'i bcud bsdu ba sogs nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ rang dang slob ma'i tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug la/ tshe zan sogs mgon po tshe dpag med pa gsum gyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du thim/ bdud rtsir gyur cing tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad sor chud par bsams la/ a mā ra ṇi brgya'am nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi bcud thams cad bsdus gong bzhin bum pa rnams kyi nang du thim pas bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la gong bzhin sngags bzla/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams bsdus bum pa rnams su song nas bdud rtsir gyur pa sngags bzla ba sogs 'dra/ yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ bum pa rnams su thim pas bdud rtsir gyur pa/ sngags bzla ba sogs 'dra'o// gsum pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/

slob ma du yod kyis phyag dang yon phul la/ las kyi slob mas me tog bkye bsdu tshar ba dang*/ slob dpon gyis/ 'o/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa gsungs pa las/ bla ma rnams kyi gtso che ba'i dbang du mdzad nas nub phyogs bde ba can gyi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dang*/ steng phyogs kyi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa gnyis las/ 'di nub phyogs kyi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i lugs yin zhing*/ de la yid ches par bya ba'i phyir sngon gyi lo rgyus cung zad brjod na/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa de nyid kyis te phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po'i drung du chos gsan du byon/ chos rnams yongs su rdzogs nas bod du 'byon par chas pa'i tshe/ te phu pa'i zhal nas chos ni mkhas par shes/ 'jig rten gyi lo rgyus 'dra yang dgos pas de ring tshong 'dus pha gir ltas mo la song zhig gsungs nas thugs mnyes bzhin byon pas de'i lam kha na mchod rten dkar po ngo mtshar ba zhig 'dug pa la phyag dang bskor ba zhig bya snyam phyag phul te bskor ba mdzad pas/ mchod rten gyi ngos cig na/ rnal 'byor pa sngo sang nge ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa phrag pa la bkal nas rwa dung 'bud bzhin pa cig 'dug pa des spyan 'bru tshugs su cher gzigs nas/ khyod la zla ba gsum gyi tshe las mi 'dug gsungs pa dang thugs shin tu zhed cing dngangs te log nas/ te phu pa'i drung du lo rgyus zhus pas/ khyod la tshe de las mi 'dug pa ngas kyang shes te/ smra ma nus pa yin gsungs/ 'o na 'chi ba de las zlog pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ngas mi yong tsan+dan gyi nags khrod pha gi na ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo zhes bya ba tshe dpag med dngos su grub pa cig yod pas/

der song la gdams pa zhus shig gsungs pa dang*/ gser srang bzhi yod pa khyer te tsan+dan gyi nags khrod du btsal bas/ tsan+dan gyi sdong po shin tu ngo mtshar zhing yal 'dab lo ma sogs rgyas pa zhig gi drung na/ rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar smug 'od zer du ma 'phro zhing 'du ba zil che ba gcig bzhugs 'dug pa la/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo yin snyam gser srang gsum gdams ngag gi yon du phul te/ tshe sgrub khyad par can cig zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas gnang ste phyi'i dbang tshe dpag med lha sum cu rtsa bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur bas rgyud sbyangs/ mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i tshe 'gugs la sogs pa nang gi dbang bskur bas byin gyis brlabs/ lha gcig bum gcig brten nas gsang ba'i dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur te/ tshe yi dzap la brten nas tshe sring ba'i gdams pa ma lus pa gnang*/ gser srang gang gis sgrub brgyags mdzad de zla ba bdun bsgoms pas dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi'i bar du sku tshe bsrings pa'i mtshan ltas bzang po byung*/ de dus dgung lo bzhi bcu bzhes pa'i steng du bsnan pas brgyad cu gya bzhi'i bar du sku tshe bsrings thub pa yin/ de nas te phu pa'i drung du log byon te lo rgyus zhus pas/ gdams pa nga la yang yod de khyed dus ma yin pa'i 'chi bas nyen pa la ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub brnyes shing*/ tshe dpag tu med pa la chos dngos su gsan pa yin pas yid ches shing byin rlabs che bas na brdzangs pa yin gsungs te/ te phu pas man ngag rdzogs par gnang*/ de nas bod du byon te rje btsun mi la dang mjal ba'i dus su/ mi la'i zhal nas sngar bod du gtan nas ma 'gyur zhing ma grags pa'i zab pa las kyang ches zab pa'i chos shig nged la skyes su phul cig gsungs pa la brten/ bla ma'i bka' ma gcog par gdams pa zab mo 'di legs par phul ba yin te/

de'ang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pas ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo la gnang*/ des te phu gsang sngags sdong po la/ des ras chung rdo rje grags pa la/ des dbang phyug mi la ras pa la gnang ste rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa ma nyams par byon pa'i gdams pa zab mo sgrub par byed pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba bdag nyid sangs rgyas su bskyed pa/ bzlas pa bya ba/ tshe zan/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril sogs mgon po tshe dpag tu med par yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba tshe 'gugs dngos/ tshe yi dzap bzlas pa sogs 'khor dang bcas pa da lan nas kyi gnas skabs su song nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa tha dad med pa la dbang bskur zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ khyed rang rnams rgyud dag par bya ba'i phyir du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas byang sems tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong bram ze'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'i spyan sngar khyed rang rnams 'khod nas sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed dgos pas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du yi ge hrīḥdamar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las mgon po tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhes pa nas/

tsheg drag dang bcas pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin brjod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas nub phyogs bde ba can nas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyi bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la thim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs te gsol ba btab pa ni/ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan/ de ltar tshe dpag tu med pa yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe yar ba dang*/ 'thor ba sdud pa'i don tu dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi tshe zan sogs tshe dpag tu med pa rnams la gus 'dud drag po dung ba zhig byas pa'i de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ khyed rang rnams sngon chad nyon mongs pa dang*/ nad drag pos gdungs pa dang*/ mi 'dod pa thog tu babs pa la sogs pa'i dus su/ tshe dang bsod nams rnams shar phyogs dri za'i lag tu shor ba/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i lag tu shor ba/ nub phyogs chu lha'i lag tu shor ba/ byang phyogs gnod sbyin gyi lag tu shor ba/ shar lho me lha'i lag tu shor ba/ lho nub srin po'i lag tu shor ba/ nub byang rlung lha'i lag tu shor ba/ byang shar bgegs bdag lag tu shor ba/ steng phyogs lha'i lag tu shor ba/ 'og phyogs klu'i lag tu shor ba/ bdud dang gshin rje'i lag tu shor ba/ ma mo rgyal 'gong la sogs pa mi ma yin sde brgyad kyi lag tu shor ba rnams rang dbang med par bkug khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i phyag gi bum par thim/

de nyid 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par bun bun khol zhing lud bum pa'i kha nas mar zham byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo dang ba spu'i bu ga nas sib sib thim ste lus kyi nang thams cad khrig mer gyis gang ba la brten nas tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad sor chud/ slar yang tshe dang bsod nams thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'phel zhing rgyas ba'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod cing dril gsil dang*/ khrom lta bu yin na rol mo bya/ nas sogs 'thor ba'i tshul tsam byas la/ a mā ra ṇi brjod/ rol mo bzhag la/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /tshe mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub zab mo thob par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ dril bu gsil zhing*/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams tshe yi bcud bsdu ba'i don du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag tu med pa rnams dang*/ spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa rnams la gus 'dud byas pas de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyi rol na yod pa'i 'byung ba chen po sa'i rigs su gyur pa 'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ gser gyi ri bdun/ gzhan yang g.ya' ri dang*/ gangs ri dang*/ rdza ri dang*/ spang ri dang*/ spos ri la sogs pa dang*/ rtsi shing nags tshal/ 'bru bcud/ gser dngul/ zangs lcags la sogs pa sra shing 'thas pa sa'i rigs su gyur pa rnams la phog pas de dag gi ro bcud dang*/ nus pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la thim/ de nyid 'chi med tshe yi chu rgyun du zhu ba sogs nas mer gyis gang ba'i bar gong bzhin la brten nas tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas te sra ba brtan pa/

gang gis kyang gzhom gzhig mi nus pa/ rdo rje dang*/ ri'i rgyal po lta bur gyur/ a mā ra ṇi rol mo dang tshe mi 'gyur ba'i sogs 'dra/ de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ slar yang khyed rang rnams slob dpon mdun bskyed spyi bo'i steng sogs kyi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa rnams la gus 'dud byas pas de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa sogs 'dra phyi rol na yod pa'i 'byung ba chen po chu'i rigs su gyur pa phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ gzhan yang chu bo chen po nai rañja ra dang*/ gaṅgā dang*/ pak+ṣu dang*/ sin+dhu la sogs pa rnams dang*/ spang chu dang*/ g.ya' chu dang*/ gangs chu dang*/ spos chu la sogs pa brlan zhing gsher ba chu'i rigs su gyur pa rnams la phog pas nas/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du ces pa'i bar gong bzhin/ 'phel zhing rgyas te lus snum bag dang ldan par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags dang*/ rol mo la sogs 'dra/ dge 'dun dam pa sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ slar yang gus 'dud byas pas de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pa sogs 'dra/ phyi rol na yod pa'i 'byung ba chen po me'i rigs su gyur pa dus mtha'i me dang*/ rta gdong gi me dang*/ me shel dang*/ me rdul dang*/ nyi ma la sogs pa tsha zhing rtsub pa me'i rigs su gyur pa rnams la phog pas nas/ 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i bar 'dra/ lus bkrag mdangs phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol sogs 'dra/ rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// lha rnams kun gyis legs par bsam pa dang*// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi mthu stobs dang*// bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden tshig gis// bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan pa dang*// sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ slar yang gus 'dud byed pa/ 'od zer 'phro ba sogs 'dra/ phyi rol na yod pa'i 'byung ba chen po rlung gi rigs su gyur pa shar na 'jam pa'i rlung*/

nub na rtsub pa'i rlung*/ nam mkha' na spu gri'i rlung*/ gzhan yang khyab byed kyi rlung*/ 'degs byed kyi rlung*/ 'phul byed kyi rlung la sogs pa yang zhing g.yo ba 'byung ba rlung gi rigs su gyur pa rnams la phog pas nas/ 'phel zhing rgyas te bar 'dra/ lus stobs dang yang rtsal phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol sogs 'dra/ bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ slar yang gus 'dud byed pa/ 'od zer 'phro ba sogs 'dra/ phyi rol na yod pa'i 'phags pa nyan thos/ rang sangs rgyas/ khams kyi rgyal phran dang*/ paṇ+ḍi ta dang*/ tshe yi rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang*/ drang srong dang*/ bram ze'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ mi bsod nams chen po la sogs pa bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams mthu dang nus pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i phyag gi bum par thim zhes pa nas/ 'phel zhing rgyas pas tshe nyi zla gnas kyi bar du thub pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol sogs 'dra/ lo brgya thub cing sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ slar yang gus 'dud/ 'od zer 'phro ba sogs 'dra/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ spyi bo'i steng gi tshe dpag tu med pa'i bum par thim/ de nyid 'chi med tshe yi chu rgyun du zhu ba sogs nas mer gyis gang ba'i bar 'dra/ gang ba la brten nas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa/ khyad par dus ma yin par 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ 'chi ba med pa tshe yi dngos grub thob pa'i mos pa mdzod/ sngags rol sogs 'dra/ sbyin pa btang zhing sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig byas pas tshe dpag tu med pa'i dpral ba'i oṃ las 'chi med tshe yi chu rgyun 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa dpag tu med pa byung*/

khyed rang rnams kyi dpral ba nas thim pas lus kyi nang gang*/ lus kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag bum pa'i dbang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'chi med tshe yi chu rgyun 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas lus kyi nang gang*/ ngag gi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag gsang ba'i dbang thob/ gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'chi med tshe yi chu rgyun 'od zer sngon po'i rnam par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas/ lus kyi nang gang*/ yid kyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs las 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi sgo gsum du thim pas lus kyi nang gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag dbang bzhi pa thob/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i byin rlabs dang nus mthu ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ tshe zan/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril sogs mgon po tshe dpag tu med par bskyed pa thams cad dang*/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag tu med pa rnams 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun 'od zer dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa'i rnam par 'od du mer gyis zhu/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pa'i rkyen gyis khyed rang rnams pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du skad cig gis mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ nyin mo bde legs sogs kyi bkra shis brjod/ de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung snyam pas/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi dang 'dra/ de nas slob ma rnams tshe bum gyi 'og tu 'grim zhing las slob kyis tshe chab dang*/ tshe ril/ slob dpon gyis byin rlabs bya zhing phyag nas cung zad tsam re ster/ ma rdzogs par rol mo dang*/ a mā ra ṇi'i sgra bya/ yang khrom chos ma yin par slob ma nyi shu phyin yin na/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i rjes la slob dpon bzhengs te/ slob ma rnams kyi spyi bor tshe bum bzhag tshe chang*/ tshe ril gyi tshe dpag med zhu ba'i bdud rtsi sbyin par bsams la/ las slob kyis tshe ril dang tshe chang 'gyed/ de ltar tshar ba dang*/ tshe bum dang spyi bo'i steng gi tshe dpag tu med pa bstim pa/ slob ma lhar bskyed pa man 'dra/ yang brgya rtsa lta bu dgos na tshe chang*/ tshe ril ster ba yan 'dra bar byas la/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med dang*/ tshe bum mi bstim par/ tshe bum las mar me gcig las gnyis chad kyi tshul du tshe dpag med gcig chad nas slob ma'i spyi bor thim pas slob ma tshe dpag med du bskyed pa'o// de nas slar yang gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pas bdag la 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ lan gcig de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa de nyid gsal lam ste mngon sum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon dang tshe zan/ spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa rnams la gus 'dud drag po dud pa byas pa sogs nas/

slob ma tshe dpag tu med pa bskyed pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ tshig rgyas bsdus rang gi blo dang bstun/ bkra shis dang dril gsil mi byed do// yang de las kyang bsdu na/ gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa de nyid gsal lam ste mngon gsum du bzhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon dang tshe zan/ spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa rnams la gus 'dud drag po dud pa byas pa sogs nas/ slob ma tshe dpag tu med pa bskyed pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ tshig rgyas bsdus rang gi blo dang bstun/ bkra shis dang dril gsil mi byed do// yang de las kyang bsdu na/ gsol gdab/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med gsal 'debs/ gus 'dud sogs 'dra/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu spros/ khyed rang rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams shor zhing nyams pa thams cad rang dbang med par bkug spyi bo'i steng gi tshe dpag tu med pa'i bum par thim/ 'chi med tshe'i chu rgyun du khol zhing lud/ spyi bo nas thim pas tshe dang bsod nams sor chud cing 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a mā ra ṇi dang*/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung sogs brjod/ yang gus 'dud/ 'od zer 'phro ba 'dra/ phyi rol na yod pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi la sogs pa snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi ro bcud thams cad bsdus spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i phyag gi bum par thim/ bdud rtsi khol zhing lud nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim pas tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a mā ra ṇi sogs 'dra/ yang gus 'dud/ 'od zer 'phro ba sogs 'dra/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams bsdus/ phyag gi bum par thim/ bdud rtsi khol zhing lud khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor thim zhing*/

tshe dang bsod nams rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a mā ra ṇi sogs 'dra/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems spyan drangs pa man 'dra'o// de las kyang bsdu na gsol ba gdab/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med gsal 'debs/ gus 'dud sogs 'dra/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams shor zhing sogs nas/ 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i mos pa mdzod kyi bar gong bsdus pa'i skabs bzhin/ a mā ra ṇi gsum brjod/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i sogs/ slar yang de la gus 'dud byas pas/ de dag gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyi rol na yod pa'i 'byung ba chen po bzhi la sogs pa phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi ro bcud thams cad dang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can thams cad rang dbang med par bkug khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i phyag gi bum par thim sogs nas/ mos pa mdzod kyi bar gong bsdus pa'i skabs ltar brjod/ a mā ra ṇi sogs 'dra/ gus 'dud 'od zer 'phro ba sogs 'dra/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i phyag gi bum par thim/ de nyid 'chi med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du khol zhing lud/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sogs man gong rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin brjod/ a mā ra ṇi sogs 'dra/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la gus 'dud drag po dung pa zhig mdzad pas mgon po tshe dpag med pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dbang bzhi thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod la/ a mā ra ṇi bzla zhing*/ tshe bum slob ma rnams kyi mgo thog tu bzhag tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ de 'dra ba brgya rtsa sogs du dgos kyang bskyar nas byed pa'o// dbang rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ tshe bum gyi tshe dpag med kyang bstims te/ slob ma tshe dpag med du bskyed pa sogs byas la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dkyus bzhin no// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag med zhu zhing bstims tshar bas mchod pa sogs gang yang mi dgos so// slob dpon gyis yig brgya tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo zhing bkra shis gang 'os bya'o// ces pa 'chi ba slu ba'i thabs// ras chung rdo rje grags pa las// nye bar brgyud pa'i gdams pa mchog /rje btsun bla ma'i phyag len bzhin// za nyal 'chag gi rnal 'byor pa// ngag gi dbang pos rigs kyi bu// spun gnyis nyams su blang phyir bris// dge des 'chi med thob par shog /sarba maṅga laṃ// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ mgon po tshe dpag med/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ te phu gsang sngags kyi sdong po/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ dbang phyug mi la ras chen/ bka' brgyud dwags po lha rje/ bde gshegs phag mo gru pa/ 'bri gung 'jig rten mgon po/ thugs sras spyan snga rin po che/ rgyal ba yang dgon chos rje/ rje spyan snga ba/ 'ba' ra ba rgyal mtshan dpal bzang*/ zur phug pa rin chen dpal bzang*/ gangs can kun dga' dpal bzang*/ dbu ma dpal ldan bzang po/ chos rje dpal mgon pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'o// shu bhaṃ// ༈ /tshe dpag med kyi dbang gi cho ga 'chi med 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bud+dha siṃ hā ya/

'dir tshe dzap la brten nas tshe sring ba'i cho ga 'chi med 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs zhes bya ba la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su bla bre dang yol ba dgram/ tshe dpag med kyi lugs sku'am thang sku sogs dgram/ de'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs pa'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi'am/ me tog gi tshom bu lnga byas pa'i steng du tshe bum gyi mthar tshe ril gyis bskor ba la tshe zan zer/ tshe chang*/ gtor ma gsum rnams 'bri mog gis byug mar gyi rgyan ci mdzes byas pa bshams pa'i mdun nam mthar chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog sogs mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bsham mo// gnyis pa la gsum las/ dang po bdag bskyed bsgom pa ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swā hā sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā/ dharmā ra ṇi lan gsum dang rol mo byas te byin gyis brlab bo// skyabs 'gro spyi dang 'dra/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du tshe dpag tu med pa bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum brjod/ rang skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ tshe dpag tu med pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a mi tā bha hrīḥ.oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā sogs nas shab+da swā hā/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum brjod/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang zhes sogs brjod/ swā bhā was bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems nyid hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hrīḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog bye ru'i lhun po la nyi ma shar ba ltar rab tu dmar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan dkyus ring zhing spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis 'gro ba mtha' dag la thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa/ 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings shing lhag ma cung zad 'phyang ba/ phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥdamar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas bde ba can nas tshe dpag tu med pa la sogs nas/ shab+da swā hā'i bar gong ltar bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med pa thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs snga ma ltar bya/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/

de la mtshan sngags re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar/ dharmā ra ṇi sogs bcas rol chen dang*/ dri med gzhom gzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las// thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul// pad+ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba// skyob pa mtshungs med 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas skor du 'khor ba las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ 'od zer 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsi dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ rang gi spyi bo'i gtsug nas zhugs te lus kyi nang thams cad khengs/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur/ oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa la sogs pa ci nus bzla/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya'o// gnyis pa mdun bskyed bsgrubs te tshe 'gugs shing bstim pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyis mgon gyur cing*// sogs sh+lo ka gsum gyis spyan drang*/ de la mchod pa sogs nas rigs bdag gi rgyas 'debs bar bdag bskyed ltar bya/ mchod pa byin rlabs gong bzhin la dharmā ra ṇi mi brjod/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa rnams// rgyal ba tshe dpag med la 'bul// tshe dang ye shes stsal du gsol// mtshan sngags sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod/

de tsam mi nus na sngags mchod bstod pa rnams bdag bskyed ltar bya'o// gtor ma rnams chu gtsang mas bran/ gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ a mi ta bha hrīḥ.oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ mtshan sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i sogs kyis bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la sogs nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gong ltar gsol ba btab bo// gnyis pa phyogs skyong la/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ zhes sogs nas/ da sha dik lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pa'i bar cha gsum ltar btang ngo*// gsum pa gzhi bdag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bhu mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar/ oṃ a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ gzhi bdag chen po 'khor bcas rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs nas kun 'grub shog /ces brjod/ mtshan sngags kyi mjug tu gats+tsha btags pas gshegs su gsol/ dzap bzlas ni/ tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas 'byung ba sa chu me rlung gi nus pa dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha klu grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa sogs kyi tshe 'dzin cing gnas pa'i nus pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa tshur 'dus te mdun bskyed kyi tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon nas/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur par bsams nas sngags bzlas pa dang 'dod don gsol btab rnams bdag bskyed ltar bya'o// gsum pa dbang bskur ba ni/

snod ldan gyi slob ma gnyis dang bzhi dang drug dang brgyad la sogs pa rnams khrus byas phyag dang yon phul gral la 'khod pa la/ las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu grub rjes slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang*/ 'khor ba las sgrol 'dod kyi snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ 'o nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du mngon par dbang bskur ba zab mo gsan la don tshul bzhin du nyams su blang snyam pa'i bsam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu thugs bskyed pa dang*/ chos gsan pa'i kun tu spyod pa thams cad kyang theg pa che chung nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin legs bar gsal btab nas gsan par zhu/ de la rang re rnams kyis rnyed par dka' ba'i dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob/ mjal bar dka' ba'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang mjal/ bstan pa'i snying po zab mo rdo rje theg pa'i lam nyams su blang du yod pa'i skabs 'dir dam pa'i chos rnam par dag pa re bya dgos/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ rtsa ba'i rgyud brtag pa gnyis pa las/ sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// de bsal na ni sangs rgyas nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ don dam par sems can thams cad rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i sangs rgyas kyi snying po can yin na yang*/ gnas skabs su glo bur gyi dri ma sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma spangs kyi bar la/ byis pa mi shes pa'i sgrib pas// de yi 'gro ba mi shes pa// 'gro ba drug gi srid pa'i mthar// gang zhig rmongs pas 'khor bar 'gyur// zhes dang*/ mdo dran pa nyer gzhag las/ sems can dmyal ba dmyal mes nyams// yi dwags bkres shing skom pas nyams// dud 'gro gcig la gcig zas nyams// mi dag 'tsho ba thung bas nyams// lha dag bag med pa yis nyams// 'khor ba khab kyi rtse tsam la// bde ba nam yang yod ma yin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

de rnams la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa ji lta bu zhig yod snyam na/ ngan song gsum ni sdug bsngal dngos la longs spyod/ mtho ris gsum ni sdug bsngal gyi rgyu mi dge ba rngam po che la longs spyod pa shas che ba yin no// mdor na rgyun chad med par sdug bsngal gyi 'khor mo yug tu gyur pa'i 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig las ma 'das pa yin te/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin du shes nas/ de las thar bar byed pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos nyams su len pa la rten dal 'byor gyi mi lus skyon med pa zhig thob dgos te/ sdong po bkod pa las/ mir gyur pa yang rnyed par dka'/ dal ba phun sum tshogs pa yang rnyed par dka'/ zhes gsungs shing*/ rnyed pa de yang phan thogs shin tu che ste/ gang zhig thob nas skye ba'i rgya mtsho mthar phyin zhing*// byang chub mchog gi sa bon dge ba'ang 'debs 'gyur la// yid bzhin nor bu bas kyang yon tan ches lhag pa'i// mi nyid thob nas su zhig 'bras bu med par byed// bde gshegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur cing*// sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i// lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed lha min dang*// mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi'am ci dang lto 'phyes min// zhes gsungs/ thob pa'i dal ba de yang yun ring du gnas pa'i nges pa'ang med de/ bshes spring las/ tshe 'di gnod mang rlung nang mar me bzhin// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs dbyung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis log pa las// sad khoms gang lags de ni ngo mtshar che// zhes gsungs pas/ dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob pa'i skabs 'dir/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po las brgal zhing*/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i thabs la 'bad dgos te/ sngar las dkar po bsags pas sangs rgyas kyi lam bsgrub pas chog pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus 'di thob 'dug cing*/

dal 'byor gyi rgyu dge ba sna re tsam bsgrub pa'ang dka' na dal 'byor thob pa smos ci dgos/ des na dal 'byor thob pa yun ring du gnas pa'i nges pa mi 'dug pas thob dka' la phan yon che zhing*/ yun ring du mi gnas pa'i lus rten thob pa'i skabs 'dir dal 'byor la snying po blang dgos pa yin no// de yang 'o skol rnams kyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang*/ dbang po dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ bag la nyal ba la sogs pa'i gnyen por chos kyi phung po ji snyed cig gsungs pa yin te/ bsdu na/ mdzod las/ spyod pa rnams kyi gnyen por ni// chos kyi phung po mthun par gsungs// zhes gsungs pa la brten nas gdul bya 'dod gdung shas chung zhing de spangs pas byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i dbang po brtul po de dag la dgongs nas rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gsungs/ gdul bya 'dod gdung shas che zhing de dag spong mi nus par bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i dbang po rnon po dag la dgongs nas/ 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa gsungs pa las/ 'dir sngags kyi theg pa yin/ de la yang rgyud sde bzhi las 'dir spyod pa'i rgyud yin/ de la yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs kyi rgyud dang*/ rdo rje'i rigs kyi rgyud dang gsum las/ 'dir de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi rgyud yin/ de la yang du ma zhig yod pa las/ 'dir 'jam dpal dpa' po grub pa'i rgyud kyi rjes su 'brang ba ste/ de la yang zhi rgyas la sogs pa dang rjes su 'brel ba'i yi dam gyi lha'i rigs mi 'dra ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa las/ 'dir rgyas pa'i rigs su gtogs pa gnas skabs su tshe dang bsod nams la sogs pa rgyas pa dang*/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo nas brgyud pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa lha gcig bum gcig gi dbang bskur ba la/

thog mar yid ches shing khungs btsun par bya ba'i phyir lo rgyus cung zad tsam brjod na/ ras chung rdo rje grags pa de nyid te phu pa gsang sngags kyi sdong po'i drung du byon nas chos rnams rdzogs par zhus nas/ bod du 'byon par chas pa'i dus su bla ma'i gsung gis/ de ring grong khyer gyi tshong dus su ltas mor rgyug cig gsungs nas byon pas/ rnal 'byor pa sngo sang nge ba ri dwags kṛṣ+ṇa sā ra'i pags pa phrag pa la bkal nas/ rwa dung 'bud pa zhig 'dug pas/ des spyan cher gzigs nas khyed la zla ba gsum gyi tshe las mi 'dug ang gsungs pas shin tu bred de/ bla ma'i drung du byon nas lo rgyus zhus pas/ bla mas khyed la tshe de las mi 'dug pa ngas kyang shes te ma smras pa yin gsungs/ 'o na 'chi ba de las zlog pa'i gdams pa zab mo zhig zhu zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ngas mi yong tsan+dan gyi nags khrod pha gi na ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo zhes bya ba tshe dpag tu med pa dngos su grub ba zhig yod pas/ de'i drung du song la gdams ngag zhus shig gsungs nas/ gser srang bzhi yod pa khyer te/ ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo'i drung du phyin nas/ gser srang gsum chos yon du phul/ srang gang la chos zhu ba'i spyad pa byas te dbang zhus nas zla ba bdun bsgrubs pas lo bzhi bcu zhe bzhi'i bar du sku tshe bsrings pa yin gsungs/ de yang sngar khong gis bzhi bcu bzhes pa dang bcas pa kun dril ba'i lo brgyad cu gya bzhi'i bar du sku tshe bsrings thub pa yin/ de nas te phu pa'i drung du log byon pa dang*/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ gdams ngag ngas kyang shes te ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo khungs btsun zhing yid ches pa'i gnas yin pas btang ba yin gsungs nas/ bla mas kyang tshar gcig rdzogs par gnang ngo*// de nas bod du byon nas rje btsun mi la dang mjal ba'i dus su mi la'i gsung nas/ sngar bod du ma grags pa'i zab chos khyad par can zhig nga la skyes su phul cig gsungs nas/

chos 'di bla ma'i bka' ma chog par skyes su phul pa yin/ de nas brtsams te rang re'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams la rim pa bzhin bka' babs pa 'di la tshe dzap la brten nas tshe sring ba dang*/ bskyed rdzogs la brten nas tshe sring ba dang*/ bcud len la brten nas tshe sring ba rnams su yod pa las/ 'dir tshe dzap la brten nas tshe'i dbang bskur ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bya ba dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po grub zin nas/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ slob dpon la mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa dngos yin snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pa'i sgo nas tshe dbang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas phyag snyims pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dga' chen khyod bdag sogs nas/ gzhug tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i tshe dpag tu med pa la/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshe'i rig 'dzin brnyes pa'i lha dang drang srong gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar mngon sum du bzhugs par mos par byas la/ de dag gi spyan sngar rang dang gzhan gyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pa'i bsam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs nas 'grub par shog ces sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi'i dbang bskur ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdamar po sogs nas/ dbur brgyan par mos nas/ de la yid kyis gus 'dud dang bcas pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/
mgon po tshe dpag tu med pas bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pa'i

bdag bskyed ltar la bdag nyid ces pa'i tshig dor/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ zhes dang*/ 'di la dbang bskur zhes bsgyur/ rkyen gyis khyed rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i sa bon dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥganyis ka las 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi bla tshe yar ba dang*/ nyams pa dang*/ gzhom pa dang*/ tshe dang bsod nams rnams bdud dang gshin rje/ btsan dang dmu/ the'u rang dang ma mo/ rgyal 'gong la sogs pas khyer ba rnams 'od zer gyis rang dbang med par bkug ste/ bdud rtsi 'o ma'i kha dog lta bu skya na ra ra phyogs bcu nas byung zhing khyed rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon nas/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur te/ khol zhing lud pas bum pa'i kha nas mar zhal la byung ba khyed rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thim pas tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad sor chud cing*/ slar yang 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ me tog gtor zhing rol mo bya/ ngag tu a mā ra ṇi sogs/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /tshe mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs nas bkra shis dang po yin/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon dang khyed rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas/ phyi rol na yod pa'i dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi dang*/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab dang*/ gser gyi ri bdun dang*/ ri bo gangs can la sogs pa'i gangs ri dang*/

ma la ya la sogs pa'i g.ya' ri dang*/ spos ngad ldan la sogs pa'i spang ri dang*/ ri bo 'bigs byed la sogs pa'i brag ri dang*/ nags tshal dang*/ rtsi shing dang*/ shing thog dang*/ 'bru dang*/ sman dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams kyi ro bcud dwangs ma thams cad bsdus te bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mdog lta bu skya na ra ra byung zhing*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi bum pa'i nang du byon nas/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur te/ khol zhing lud pas bum pa'i kha nas mar zha la la byung khyed rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas thim pas/ lus thams cad 'chi med bdud rtsis khengs te/ lus sra zhing brtan pa gzhom gzhig mi nus pa ri rab dang rdo rje lta bur gyur pa yin snyam du mos pa mdzod/ de yis nye bar bstan pa'i sogs nas bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ zhes brjod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ sogs nas 'phros pas/ phyi rol na yod pa'i chu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ phyi'i rgya mtsho dang*/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun dang*/ chu bo chen po bzhi dang*/ nai rañja ra/ gaṅgā/ pak+ṣu/ sin+dhu la sogs pa rnams dang*/ gzhan yang lteng ka dang*/ chu mig dang*/ chu klung dang*/ chu bran la sogs pa chu'i sde tshan thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams sogs nas khengs te lus snum bag dang ldan par gyur pa yin snyam du sogs nas/ dge 'dun dam pa zhes pa nas bkra shis gsum pa yin/ zhes brjod/ yang dmigs pa sogs nas/ 'od zer nyi ma shar ba lta bu 'phros pas/ me'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ gzhan yang rta gdong gi me dang*/ rgod ma kha'i me dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ nor bu dang*/ rgyun gzhag gi me dang*/ brdabs pa dang*/ gtsubs pa la sogs pa rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sogs nas khengs te/ lus bkrag mdangs dang ldan par gyur pa yin snyam du sogs nas/ rgyal ba sras bcas sogs brjod/ yang dmigs pa sogs nas 'phros pas/ phyi rol na yod pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang*/

bye brag tu 'thor byed kyi rlung dang*/ sdud byed kyi rlung la sogs pa rnams la phog pas/ de rnams kyi sogs nas khengs te lus stobs dang yang rtsal chen por gyur pa yin snyam du sogs nas/ bgegs rigs stong phrag sogs brjod/ yang dmigs pa sogs nas 'phros pas/ phyi rol na yod pa'i rigs drug gis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas/ de rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dang dbang thang la sogs pa thams cad bsdus te bdud rtsi 'o ma'i mdog lta bu sogs nas/ khengs te khyed rang gi tshe dang bsod nams bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur pa yin snyam du sogs nas/ lo brgya thub cing sogs brjod/ yang dmigs pa sogs nas/ 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas/ de thams cad kyi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'o ma'i mdog lta bu sogs nas/ khengs te tshe dang bsod nams thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du sogs nas/ sbyin pa gtong zhing sogs brjod/ slar dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba'i dmigs pa 'di dpe la lar mi snang zhing*/ rkyen sel lta bu la ma byas kyang rung ngo*// yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med la gus 'dud drag po dung ba zhig mdzad pas mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du rim dang gcig car du thim pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dbang bzhi thob/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces brjod la/ a mā ra ṇi sogs bzla'o// slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

tshe zan dang tshe chang dang khyed rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med gsum ka yang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi rnam par zhu nas khyed rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas/ khyed rang skad cig gis tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can re rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyis sngags brjod cing tshe bum mgo bor bzhag tshe zan dang tshe chang yang sbyin/ slar me tog gtor nas/ 'byung po gang dag sogs brjod/ yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bde ba can na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyi thugs ka nas tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te/ khyed rang rnams tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku can du gsal ba la thim pas/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ rgyud byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ a mā ra ṇi dang*/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i sogs dang*/ nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod/ des dbang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ mdor na de dag gi gnas skabs su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa las bsrung sdom bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ dbang yongs su rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas lus longs spyod la sogs pa yang drin lan du 'bul na/ cha shas nas bzhes la longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs brjod/ des tshe dbang zab mo legs par gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa sogs brjod de slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo*// gsum pa ni/ bla mas yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/

ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bsngo ba dang smon lam bkra shis dga' ston sogs bya'o// 'di ltar bgyis pa'i dge tshogs mthus// bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis// dus min 'chi bdag bcom nas ni// 'chi med dbang po thob par shog /ces pa 'di ni mus chen sangs rgyas rin chen gyis mdzad pa'i gsung rab la gzhi byas/ bla ma dam pa'i phyag len dang gsung sgros cung zad kyis brgyan te/ aṃ gi ra zhes pa chu pho spre'u'i lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i dkar phyogs la/ yon tan rin po che du ma'i 'byung gnas shrī e waṃ chos ldan gyi ri khrod thar pa rtser brang ti pa'i btsun pa ga ga na shrī bha dras sbyar ba'o// 'dis sems can thams cad kyi tshe mthar phyin par gyur cig/ ༈ /tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs skur tshul gyi phyag len 'chi med myur lam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ 'dir thar rtse paṇ+ḍi ta chen po nam mkha' dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i tshe dpag med grub rgyal lugs kyi dbang chog 'chi med 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs dang rjes su 'brel bar tshe dbang brgya rtsa sogs grangs gsog skabs/ rgyas pa tshar gcig gis slob ma thun mong ba la 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bcud bsdu ba'am/ thun mong ma yin pa la dbang bzhi byin rlabs kyi tshul du bskur ba lan dkyus ltar song nas/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ tshe zan dang*/ tshe chang tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba dang*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med rnams las rang 'dra gnyis pa re chad/ de thams cad 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi rnam par zhu nas/ khyed rang gi spyi bor thim pas khyed rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa sku mdog bye ru'i lhun po la sogs nas/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'i sku can tu gsal lam ste gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/

tshe bum spyi bor bzhag cing snying po dang gzungs ring bzla/ spro na paṇa chen rang gis mdzad pa'i 'di'i dbang chog tshigs bcad ma las/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi zas// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis bza' bar bya// 'di zos tshe dpag med mgon gyi// zhal zas bsten na nad kun las// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pas tshe ril dang*/ bkra shis tshe brtan dpal gyi dpe la lar tshig rkang 'di med pa'ang snang*/ bcud// snying po bsdus pa'i bcud 'di ni// de ring bu yis btung bar bya// 'di btung tshe dpag med mgon gyi// btung ba bsten pas nad kun las// grol 'gyur the tshom bya mi dgos// oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wan+ti ye swā hā/ zhes pas tshe chang sbyin par gsungs pa ltar bya/ bsdu na snying po dang gzungs ring bzla bzhin pas sbyin/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig sogs dang*/ 'byung po gang dag sogs brjod/ slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sogs nas/ nyin mo bde legs sogs kyi bar dkyus ltar bya ba ni tshar dang po yin no// tshar gnyis pa man la/ slar yang gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pas bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas spyi bo'i steng na bzhugs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi thugs ka'i sa bon dang*/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu dang pho nya lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ khyed rang gi bla tshe yar ba dang*/ nyams pa dang*/ gzhom pa dang*/ gdon bgegs 'byung pos khyer ba thams cad 'ub kyis bsdus te spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon/ yang 'od zer des 'byung ba bzhi'i khams thams cad la khyab pas dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/

dbus gyi ri rgyal lhun po/ gser gyi ri bdun la sogs pa 'byung ba sa'i ro bcud dwangs ma thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi chu'i dkyil 'khor/ phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun la sogs pa 'byung ba chu'i ro bcud dwangs ma thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi me'i dkyil 'khor/ rta gdong gi me/ nyi ma/ nor bu sgron me'i 'od la sogs pa 'byung ba me'i bcud dwangs ma thams cad dang*/ 'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ 'thor byed dang sdud byed kyi rlung la sogs pa 'byung ba rlung gi ro bcud dwangs ma thams cad bsdus te phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon/ yang 'od zer des 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas pa dang*/ dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams rnams su khyab pas/ de dag na gnas pa'i sems can rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang la sogs pa thams cad dang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad bsdus te phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon/ de thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur pa khol zhing lud pas bum pa'i kha nas mar byung*/ khyed rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ nad gdon sdig sgrib dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa thams cad sor chud/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dwangs ma stobs su smin pas lus kyi zungs dang sems kyi rten du gyur cing*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ tshe zan dang*/ tshe chang dang*/ spyi bo'i steng gi tshe dpag med rnams las kyang rang 'dra gnyis pa re 'chad de khyed rang lhar gsal ba la thim pa dang lhan cig tu/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mgon po tshe dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs te khyed rang la sib sib thim pas 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dngos grub ma lus pa brtan cing nus ldan du byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/

snying po dang gzungs ring bzla bzhin du tshe bum spyi bor bzhag tshe ril dang tshe chang sbyin/ me tog 'thor zhing*/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i g.yung drung du gyur cig /tshe mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig /tshe mi shigs pa'i rdo rjer gyur cig /'chi ba med pa tshe'i dngos grub thob par gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ spro na bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gang rung brjod/ de las kyang bsdu na/ gong gi bsam gyis mi khyab pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas zhes pa'i mtshams/ khyed rang gi bla tshe yar ba/ nyams pa/ gzhom pa/ gdon bgegs 'byung pos khyer ba thams cad dang*/ 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i ro bcud dwangs ma/ sems can thams cad kyi tshe bsod dbang thang*/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad bsdus te spyi bo'i steng gi mgon po tshe dpag med kyi phyag gi bum pa'i nang du byon/ de thams cad 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur pa sogs man 'dra/ gong ltar yang tshar rjes ma'i skabs/ tshe zan dang*/ tshe chang dang*/ spyi bo'i steng gi tshe dpag med rnams kyang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub kyi rnam par 'od du ltem gyis zhu nas/ khyed rang lhar gsal ba la thim sogs brjod pa khyad par ro// de nas mthar bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad rgyas par brjod pa'i mjug tu dam tshig khas blang sogs dbang chog gi dkyus bzhin no// zhes pa'ang mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags sogs kyis mdzad pa'i tshe dbang brgya rtsa skur tshul gyi zin bris la bla ma dam pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes kyis brgyan te rtsa ba'i gzhung dang mthun par mang du thos pa'i bya bral ba 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos sbyar ba'i 'gro kun 'chi med tshe dang ye shes kyi dga' ston la longs su spyod pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //sarba dā maṅga laṃ bha ba tu//
